## Hard rules you may not violate

- T1 is the ONLY task where external training data is permitted, and only if disclosed. T2 and T3 forbid it entirely.
- Anything measured at, or biologically closer to, a held-out stage/genotype than to the nearest released stage counts as using the answer -- including a merely pretrained model, and including the Virtual Embryo atlas on the challenge's own site.
- Validation and test targets are never distributed. A submission returns a number, not data.
- No agent in this loop may upload a submission or overwrite an existing artifact. Promotion means 'queued for human review'.
- Precomputed embeddings shipped inside the h5ad files have unaudited provenance under the external-data rule; recompute from raw .X instead.
- obs_names are not unique (2811 duplicated barcodes in the Mab21l2 KO file). Never join on them.
- Spatial coordinates are per-embryo in scale AND origin; re-centre per file before pooling.
